apache/shenyu.about: Java-native API gateway for service proxy, protocol conversion and API governance.
apache/shenyu.did: Bug fixes and reliability work across `admin` / `sdk` / `bootstrap` (instance heartbeats and cluster master election, Oracle compatibility, Netty event-loop lifecycle, SDK response handling), plus traffic-shaping features in the `divide` plugin: optional sticky session affinity with deterministic key selection, and draining / readiness admission so an instance can stop taking new traffic without deregistering. Also MQTT and gRPC connection-lifecycle fixes, MCP SSE transport repair, registry cleanup and dependency slimming. Currently working on Dubbo provider identity and keeping credentials out of config sync.

agentic-ai-java/argi.about: Agent Runtime and Graph Intelligence: a Java agent framework built on Spring AI, with a graph runtime, multi-agent workflows and visual administration.
agentic-ai-java/argi.did: The opt-in ToolCall argument-validation gate (local JSON Schema `$ref` expansion, resource limits), a unified tool-failure status contract, the AgentResult delivery contract with a structured-output finalizer and registered business-outcome mapping, plus the fix for user-registered KeyStrategy loss across state cloning and snapshots. Currently working on standalone ReAct tool selection and cancelling in-flight A2A streams.

agentscope-ai/agentscope.about: Build and run agents you can see, understand and trust - a Python framework for multi-agent applications.
agentscope-ai/agentscope.did: Model-layer fixes in the Python runtime: `thinking_enable` is now tri-state for the DeepSeek and DashScope chat models, so leaving it unset no longer force-sends `thinking.type=disabled` / `enable_thinking=false` and the server default applies, while explicit on/off still behaves exactly as before.
